# Loading in Claude Code

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lumitive/lumi-style ~/src/lumi-style
ln -s ~/src/lumi-style ~/.claude/skills/lumi-style
```

Invoke: /lumi-style <task>, or say "in LUMI style…".

The skill reads `references/` and `tokens/` on demand — no need to attach them manually.

**Symlink rather than copy.** An installed copy silently stranded at 0.1.334 while the repo reached 0.1.337, and a deck was built against three versions of superseded rules. A symlink cannot go stale.

Driven with `acceptEdits` PLUS an explicit `--allowedTools` allowlist, never `bypassPermissions`. The `full` tier's claim is that the agent runs check_prose, check_design and inspect_layout itself, and acceptEdits alone permits writing files and not running commands: asked to check its own work, Claude Code stopped after 141s having written nothing and requested a `python3` allowlist entry — a tier claim the driver's own flags made impossible to meet (measured 2026-08-21). `bypassPermissions` would also have fixed it and grants arbitrary shell to an agent, on every machine that runs this harness; the allowlist grants the commands the task actually needs. WIDENED at 0.1.556: `python3` alone denied `cd <dir> && python3 …`, `sed` and `grep`, and a driven round spent 113 seconds — 9.5% of its wall clock — being refused and rephrasing. A permission the harness withholds is not a finding about the skill.

Vendor documentation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills
